where_you_are: Sir Phidipaldi is in the empty Golden Egg Tavern with its owner Quinn. Wayman Tisdale and Dr. Uriah are across the street in the Clumsy Fox Tavern. Dunk is at Farmer Gill's farm on the edge of town, where Gill has said he can sleep in the barn.

immediate_intention.text: Sir Phidipaldi and Quinn are about to stage a fake ale delivery for Quinn's promised 100 gold. Quinn will bring bottles to fill with water, and Sir Phidipaldi will make a big show of delivering them to see what happens.
